claim_scope: Exact factor-base geometry and independently checked subgroup projections. A nominal window dimension is not an actual fb count. This experiment does not measure ordinary relation yield, PDP cost, target recovery, or a complete N131 2^x.

construction.basis: The existing normal basis in each exact curve record, with coordinates indexed in the Frobenius cycle used by OrbitKey.coordinate_cycle.
construction.definition: All nonzero x whose cyclic Frobenius-coordinate support is contained in some interval of d consecutive positions. Lift rational x to both curve signs, multiply by the exact cofactor, remove identity and duplicate subgroup points.
construction.enumeration: For 2d<n, one representative per nonzero Frobenius orbit has bit 0 set and its highest set bit t in [0,d-1]; for t>0 bit t is set and interior bits 1..t-1 vary freely. The unique long zero gap gives exactly 2^(d-1) raw x orbits. Expand every projected key by both signs and all n Frobenius powers only after proving full orbit size and distinctness.
construction.enumerated_set_encoding: Sorted canonical cyclic-Frobenius projected x keys as fixed-width little-endian integers, SHA-256 over concatenated bytes.
construction.factor_base_family: Frobenius orbit union of a d-dimensional normal-basis coordinate window

run_order: N131 remains a Q design until exact enumeration and full pipeline accounting
success_criteria: The exact N53 and N83 projected sets have audited B, K, set digests, per-span counts, and sampled independent group-law checks.
The base comparison states the changed factor-base policy and preserves the exact source curves and public workloads for later PDP tests.
A follow-on solver test must use new PS1 stage IDs after B is known; Q1481 alone does not justify an IC1 candidate or N131 solve estimate.
